messages:
maria (PM): Quick async Q2 OKR check — model-routing rollout status.

maria (PM): TL;DR: partial ship: API + baseline routing live, autoscaler and canary routing slipped. Need owners to confirm remaining tasks and CRs. Quick asks: who owns the autoscaler policy? who will pick up canary config? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

kevin (EngInfra): I own autoscaler policy. Blocked by cloud quota and a perf regression in the new scheduler. I can take ownership, but need one more eng to help validate memory/cpu bump matrix tomorrow. ETA EOD Thu.

sasha (EngRuntime): Can help validate scheduler perf. Which perf regression are you seeing? Logs show KV cache eviction spikes at ~1200 concurrent requests.

kevin (EngInfra): exact spike is on test cluster-beta. snippet:
``
2026-03-15T12:01:02Z WARN kv_cache.cpp: eviction_count=312 latency_ms=14.2
``
We're rolling back a tweak but need to re-run the benchmark suite with older kernel flags.

devon (EngPlatform): Canary routing config still pending from my side — I've got the PR up but it's waiting for two CR approvals. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/plat/PR-428

emma (ProductOps): Summary for execs: shipped API + baseline routing; autoscaler + canary delayed ~4 business days. Impact: some Dedicated customers may see slower warm-up. Can we get a mitigation plan now? :point_up:

kevin (EngInfra): Mitigation: enable temporary pre-warm (low-cost) pool for 48h, reduces cold-starts. I'll open the infra ticket and the cost estimate. @devon can you add a toggle so we can flip pre-warm on/off per org?

devon (EngPlatform): yes, I'll add a feature flag. Quick snippet for the toggle in feature flags service:
``
featureFlags.set('prewarm_v2', true, {scope: 'org', ttl: 172800})
``

sasha (EngRuntime): I'll run a focused benchmark tomorrow morning (9am PT) and post results. If KV eviction is confirmed, propose reverting the specific cache eviction heuristic change and retesting.

maria (PM): Owners and next steps:
- Autoscaler policy & perf triage: kevin + sasha — validate and attempt fix (owner: kevin) — ETA Thu EOD
- Canary routing CR approvals: devon — get 2 CRs and merge, then smoke deploy (owner: devon) — ETA Wed
- Temporary prewarm toggle: devon — implement and coordinate with infra for 48h (owner: devon) — ETA Tue AM
- Exec note / mitigation: emma — send update after infra ticket and ETA known (owner: emma)

maria (PM): Please react with :thumbsup: when you ack and add any blockers. If anyone needs handoff to on-call, ping #eng-oncall.

kevin (EngInfra): ack :thumbsup: I'll post the infra ticket after lunch.

devon (EngPlatform): ack. I'll ping two reviewers (sarah, raj) — @sarah please take a look when you have a window.

sarah: on it, looking now.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment scheduled for 2026-03-17T02:00:00Z if PR merged and flags set. Will block if healthcheck fails.

sasha (EngRuntime): acked. Will post bench results in this thread.

emma (ProductOps): ack — will draft exec note with current ETA and mitigation options by EOD.

maria (PM): thanks all. I'll update the OKR doc with shipped/slipped items and link back once done: https://docs.redwood/okr/q2-model-routing

maria (PM): final note: small sync Huddle Thurs 10am PT if we need to unblock live testing. Otherwise async updates here.
